result.instructions: Tools for Quendoo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which rooms are still free in our hotel from 1 to 5 December?"; "Show me all bookings checking in this weekend and their payment status."; "What does cancelling booking 4821 cost today?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Quendoo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quendoo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quendoo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quendoo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. quendoo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quendoo_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the hotel properties this token reaches, with name, type, currency, star rating and mode (shadow or live). Good first call to get a property_id. Connect API: GET /properties.

tools.name: quendoo_get_property
tools.title: Get a property
tools.description: Read one property: address, contact details, check-in and check-out times, currency and mode. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}.

tools.name: quendoo_get_structure
tools.title: Get property structure
tools.description: Read the whole structure of one property: room types, rate plans and their links. One call instead of several. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/structure.

tools.name: quendoo_list_room_types
tools.title: List room types
tools.description: List the room types of one property, with capacity, quantity and partner code. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/room_types.

tools.name: quendoo_list_rate_plans
tools.title: List rate plans
tools.description: List the rate plans of one property: room type, meal plan, cancellation and payment policy, and occupancy rates. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/rate_plans.

tools.name: quendoo_get_availability
tools.title: Get availability
tools.description: Read the calendar per day and room type: rooms open, booked and free to sell. Use a date range of a few weeks. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/availability.

tools.name: quendoo_get_rates
tools.title: Get rates
tools.description: Read the prices and restrictions of one rate plan over a date range. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/rate_plans/{rate_plan_id}/rates.

consolidated.description: true returns one merged row per run of equal days.

tools.name: quendoo_search_offers
tools.title: Search booking offers
tools.description: Search the offers a property sells for dates and a party. Returns each offer with a search_token (valid 30 minutes) to book with quendoo_book_from_search. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/booking_offers.

children_ages.description: Ages of the children in the first room.

tools.name: quendoo_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings of one property, filtered by check-in or check-out window, status or guest name. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/bookings.

booking_status.description: Filter by booking status, for example CREATED or CANCELLED.

partner_reference.description: Your own reference, sent when you booked.

tools.name: quendoo_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Read one booking: status, payment status, dates, total amount and payment plan. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/bookings/{booking_id}.

tools.name: quendoo_get_cancellation_quote
tools.title: Get a cancellation quote
tools.description: Read what cancelling a booking costs today, under its cancellation policy. Makes no change. Connect API: GET /properties/{property_id}/bookings/{booking_id}/cancellation_quote.

tools.name: quendoo_list_booking_revisions
tools.title: List booking changes
tools.description: Read the booking change feed: created, changed and cancelled bookings not yet acknowledged. Pass next_cursor as since to continue. Reading does not acknowledge. Connect API: GET /booking_revisions/feed.

property_id.description: Limit the feed to one property.

since.description: Cursor: the next_cursor of the last answer.

tools.name: quendoo_update_availability
tools.title: Update availability
tools.description: Set the rooms to sell, and open or close room types, for date ranges. Send up to 1000 rows per call; a row covers a date range. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/inventory/availability. Writes take effect only when the property is live. In shadow mode the answer has dry: true and nothing is stored.

availability.description: Rooms to sell in the date range.

opened.description: true opens the room type for sale in the range.

closed.description: true closes the room type in the range.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. A retry with the same key is replayed, not done twice.

tools.name: quendoo_update_rates
tools.title: Update rates
tools.description: Set the price of a rate plan on a room type for date ranges. Send up to 1000 rows per call. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/inventory/rates. Writes take effect only when the property is live. In shadow mode the answer has dry: true and nothing is stored.

rate.description: Price for the date range, in the property currency.

prices.description: Prices per occupancy, in the shape the rate plan defines.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. A retry with the same key is replayed, not done twice.

tools.name: quendoo_update_restrictions
tools.title: Update restrictions
tools.description: Set stay restrictions (minimum or maximum nights, stop sell, closed to arrival or departure) for date ranges. Send up to 900 rows per call. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/inventory/restrictions. Writes take effect only when the property is live. In shadow mode the answer has dry: true and nothing is stored.

min_los.description: Minimum length of stay, in nights.

max_los.description: Maximum length of stay, in nights.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. A retry with the same key is replayed, not done twice.

tools.name: quendoo_book_from_search
tools.title: Book from a search
tools.description: Create a real booking from a search_token and the offers the guest chose. Confirm the guest, dates and price first. Returns the payment_url to send to the guest. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/bookings/from_search. Writes take effect only when the property is live. In shadow mode the answer has dry: true and nothing is stored.

search_token.description: The search_token from quendoo_search_offers. Valid 30 minutes.

items.description: A guest entry, in the shape of the offer's guests list.

request.description: true sends a booking request the hotel must approve.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. A retry with the same key is replayed, not done twice.

tools.name: quendoo_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel a whole booking. Read quendoo_get_cancellation_quote first and confirm the cost with the user. Connect API: POST /properties/{property_id}/bookings/{booking_id}/cancel.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. A retry with the same key is replayed, not done twice.

tools.name: quendoo_ack_booking_revision
tools.title: Acknowledge a booking change
tools.description: Acknowledge one booking change from quendoo_list_booking_revisions after you saved it. Acknowledging the same change again is safe. Connect API: POST /booking_revisions/{id}/ack.

revision_id.description: The numeric id of the change (from quendoo_list_booking_revisions).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key. A retry with the same key is replayed, not done twice.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Quendoo
prompts.description: What you can do with Quendoo here, with example requests to try.
